ai.title: Add file tree to file-picker and find-all-referencer system prompts
ai.summary: Injects PLACEHOLDER.FILE_TREE_PROMPT into the systemPrompt for file-picker and find-all-referencer agents. Updates import paths in find-all-referencer to use relative imports for agent-definition types. Scope limited to .agents/file-explorer/ internal agent definitions. Ensures these exploration agents receive the repository file tree structure in their initial context.

eli5.text: Two of the system's built-in exploration tools now receive a view of the repository's file structure as part of their initial instructions. When you ask the system to locate files or trace references, those tools start with the layout of the codebase already in context, so they can reason about paths and relationships without needing to discover them first. This is live today for anyone using the file-finding and reference-tracing agents, and you would see it as slightly more accurate, structurally aware responses when asking those tools to explore the code.
